response.text:
# Candidate Assessment: Mandatory Match **90%**, Proceed

## Mandatory Requirements

| # | Requirement | Résumé evidence | Match |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | Python | Languages: Python | ✅ |
| 2 | SQL | Languages: SQL | ✅ |
| 3 | Linux administration | Platform: Linux administration | ✅ |
| 4 | Git | Platform: Git | ✅ |
| 5 | REST API design | Services: REST API design | ✅ |
| 6 | Unit testing | Services: unit testing | ✅ |
| 7 | CI pipelines | Services: CI pipelines | ✅ |
| 8 | Docker, Kubernetes, Terraform, Ansible, Helm | Infrastructure: all five listed | ✅ |
| 9 | Kafka | Streaming: Kafka | ✅ |
| 10 | GraphQL | Not mentioned | ❌ |

**Match: 9 of 10 numbered requirements = 90%**

Item 8 bundles five tools. If each tool is counted separately, there are 14 skills, and the candidate matches 13 of them (**92.9%**). Both methods clear the 85% threshold, so the outcome is the same.

## Outcome

**Proceed.** The candidate exceeds the 85% threshold. The only mandatory gap is **GraphQL**.

## Nice-to-Have (for information only)

The résumé shows none of the nice-to-have items: Grafana, Prometheus, technical writing, mentoring, or public speaking. As instructed, this does not affect the outcome.

**Suggested follow-up:** In the next stage, ask about the candidate's GraphQL exposure. Their REST API design background may make it a quick skill to pick up.
